reviews.text:
Love the care and attention Bella gets each time she’s at Puppy Love.
Great Service ❤️

I had an amazing experience here! The staff is incredibly friendly and clearly loves animals. My pup came out looking fantastic, smelling great, and totally happy. You can tell they pay great attention to detail and take their time to ensure the animals are comfortable. Highly recommend!

Finding Puppy Love Yorkville has honestly been one of the best things that’s happened for my dog, Thanos, and me.

I’ve lived in the Yorkville neighbourhood for many years, so I’ve had no shortage of options when it comes to pet care and grooming. But Puppy Love stands in a league of its own. What truly sets them apart isn’t just the quality of the grooming—it’s the level of communication, transparency, and genuine care that every single person on the team provides.

From the very first phone call, you can tell you’re dealing with professionals who truly care. The team that handles scheduling for all the locations is always warm, organized, responsive, and incredibly accommodating. That level of service continues the moment you walk through the doors of the Yorkville location.

Sharon and Alessia are simply exceptional. My dog, Thanos, is a very large breed and can be highly anxious. Unfortunately, many places immediately become intimidated by his size or nervous demeanor. Sharon and Alessia never did. Instead, they took the time to understand him, earned his trust, and brought out a side of him that I wasn’t sure many people would ever get to see.

Watching the transformation has been incredible. Not only does Thanos look amazing after every visit, but he has genuinely learned to enjoy the grooming experience. In fact, every time we walk past Puppy Love Yorkville, I can tell he wants to go inside just to say hello. As a dog owner, that’s probably the biggest compliment I could ever give a grooming team.

It’s rare to find a business where you feel complete confidence every single time you leave your pet in their care. Puppy Love Yorkville has earned that trust, and I couldn’t be more grateful to have found them.

Thank you to the entire team especially Sharon and Alessia for treating Thanos like family. You are truly remarkable, and I recommend Puppy Love Yorkville without hesitation to anyone looking for exceptional care for their furry family members.❤️

Horrible, horrible experience. Long time customer for over a year or so and - had a great experience up until today.

A new groomer rescheduled my appointment last minute a few days before my original appointment, and called me repeatedly during work hours to switch the time because of a scheduling error on their side. I agreed to it (as she called on a rush when I was working), but then I realized on the day of that I couldn’t accommodate their ask due to other commitments that couldn’t be moved (and called them right away at 9 AM to see if there was another time slot that day or in a few days/a week that would work - just as how she had called me last minute to reschedule my original time). She was extremely mean/rude on the phone, and then - tried to charge ME rescheduling fees.

It was OUTRAGEOUS - trying to charge back a repeat customer because of her own errors. All I was asking for was a new grooming slot, and would have happily come at another time that worked better for everyone!! This was all due to her over-scheduling decisions!

I will NEVER come back to this groomer and they’ve lost me as a customer due to their rudeness of the new employee and attempts at collecting fees from a loyal customer - due to their own overscheduling. IMAGINE treating a customer who attends every 1.5 months this way! Disgusting experience.
Sharon at the Puppy Love Yorkville location has been grooming my two little dogs for over a year now and they always look perfect! Even better, they come out as happy as they go in!

Sam is now 14 years old and had his first ever grooming experience 1 1/2 years ago at Puppy Love. Sharon is wonderful and makes Sam feel right at home. He always looks super fantastic after his grooming session and we so appreciate Puppy Love's excellent care and service ❤️
Have been taking Cheddar, my Cavapoo, here for about 6 months now and love it!  Great care and beautiful grooming means both of us leave happy. Thanks, Sharon!

Sharon is a superb groomer - the pooches emerged relaxed and perfectly adorable. A particularly scruffy LeBron was transformed.
We love Puppy Love!
Clean bright inviting operation.  Dogs are not crated like most and get to run free
Love the Grooming Salon for my dog! She always comes out looking super cute and just how I like, plus they’re attentive and caring. Thanks guys!
5-star experience! The shop is spotless, the team is friendly, and Milo loves the atmosphere. They really go slow and prioritize my dog’s comfort over just speed. Sharon is the best! 💕 …

Honestly, I tried so many grooming spots, puppy love is gentle with dogs, they care about details and they are highly professional.
I've been to a couple of their different locations and all was amazing and high quality service 👏🏻 …
My dog always leaves looking so clean and happy. Love this place! They’re one of the best out there, highly recommend!
Our 7 year old golden retriever has been groomed at the Caledon location for the past couple of years and always looks great and shows no anxiety from the process. Great job.

We had such a great experience! The staff were kind, professional, and clearly care so much about the dogs. My pup came back looking amazing and happy, which means everything to me. You can tell they take their time and do quality work. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a groomer they can truly trust.

Never had to pay to set up a profile before on a website just to be able to maybe book a service. I'm sure it's a lovely service but you can't book a grooming without setting up a profile on their website which you can't do unless you pay them a deposit (a deposit for an appt that hasn't been booked yet).
Amazing experience. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable. They answered all my questions and ensured my dog had the best experience.

My little guy's fur has never felt softer or smelled as nice! Appreciate endlessly Sharon's patience and gentle handling -- my dog, Tofu, can be so so nervous with new experiences but he left the salon with his tail swishing happily and strutting confidently!
Very attentive staff took good care of our Golden, who is very nervous about groomers. When I picked her up, she was calm and beautiful! Will definitely return to this business!
My puppy and I love it here so much! She’s always excited to come back and the girls treat us so well.
Amazing groomers they took such good care of my baby and she looks beautiful.

My dog Harley (a 13 lbs cavapoochon) had his most recent grooming at Puppy Love in Yorkville and they were incredible. The best grooming he has had in his 5 years going for this service at various places in Toronto and LA. The space is very clean and inviting and the team is incredibly friendly and kind with the dogs. They also paid close attention to all of the details. He left looking so adorable and fluffy with a little green bow tie. Highly recommend!

Where do I begin?<3 What a lovely place this is! My furry baby loves going here! The staff are amazing, super friendly, you feel like you're apart of the family! The salon is clean and vibrant. I brought my furry baby for a creative design and they nailed it! The location is great as well, while waiting you could walk around to check out restaurants and shops for yourself. I highly recommended this place! It's worth every penny, your furry baby leaves with a cute bow all the time! My baby got a tie last time ,so cute! They also sell clothing (great quality)! My baby and I will be back for sure!
The service here is truly one of a kind.  Once you experience it you can’t go back to your average grooming.  Thank you Sharon
Everyone here is great. They do a fantastic job and are super friendly
Beautiful and Amazing puppy spa with very professional groomers , groomers and owner are very kind and friendly, my angel had a great day and looks so beautiful.100% Recommend!!❤️❤️👏😔 …

I wanted to share my appreciation for the exceptional experience I had in Puppy Love Yorkville. The team consistently demonstrates a high level of professionalism, handling every detail with care and expertise.  Their clean and well-maintained environment, coupled with excellent time management, makes it clear that they prioritize both the comfort of the pets and the satisfaction of their customers. I have never had an experience like this before - catered for pets.  Look forward to providing my Layla a quality of care I never imagined possible.  Thank you to Sharon for the unique experience

Their work is absolutely outstanding, and the staff are incredibly kind, professional, and welcoming. The environment is nothing short of breathtaking
impeccably clean, stylishly designed, and truly a pleasure to be in

Love that they don’t use cages and document the whole process so you can see how your pet is doing! My pup is an anxious guy and I hate leaving him with other people because of how nervous he gets so the transparency and constant updates really give me peace of mind. The service is pricey but worth it in my opinion for the one on one attention each dog gets.

Puppy Love is truly amazing! From the moment I walk in, the kind and attentive staff made me feel so welcome. Their care for dogs was evident in every step of the process and they truly go above and beyond with their service. The salon itself is so beautifully designed, with a calming atmosphere that makes the experience even better. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for exceptional grooming with a personal touch!

This salon really sets the standard on what Grooming should be.  I felt like I was in LA but it was Yorkville.  My dog was treated like the Queen that she is.  Thank you to the lovely ladies there.  #Professional

I wanted to give a huge shout out to  Puppy Love Yorkville and groomer Michaela. They are new to my hood and  I popped in on opening day, they were kind and considerate and let me get my dog Finch's nails trimmed, I also love their no cage …
Fantastic salon and team, no one better to trust your fur-babies with!
Michaela at Puppy Love Yorkville is the absolute best. She takes such pride and care of my little baby, Noah! Couldn’t recommend them enough!
Puppy love offers the best service, my cavapoo Teddy loves going to his spa days. They are so gentle with him and always the haircut looks amazing
